title: Break down MCP tool calls by harness
description: Group this project's MCP tool-call activity by the resolved client harness — the friendly product label for the MCP client (Claude Agent SDK, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, Claude.ai, …). Returns calls, error count, error rate, and session count per harness. Accepts the same dateRange / properties / filterTestAccounts filters as the dashboard and resolves the harness server-side over the same query runner, so results match the UI exactly. Use to answer "which harnesses use our MCP, and how reliably?".

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription: HogQL parser backend; absent → `rust_py_with_cpp_shadow` (rust-py is primary, cpp runs as a sampled shadow). `*_shadow` modes return the primary result and sample-compare against the other parser, reporting divergences without failing the request.
